# Karl Turquetil - Coach Kettlebell Caen

> > StrongFirst certified kettlebell coaching and adapted physical activity (APA) training in Caen, Normandie.

Karl Turquetil offers professional kettlebell instruction using the StrongFirst method at Studio 470 in Verson/Caen. Services include personal training, functional fitness coaching, and specialized adapted physical activity (APA) programs for diverse populations in the Calvados region.

## Key Topics

- Kettlebell training
- StrongFirst method
- Personal training Caen
- APA (Activité Physique Adaptée)
- Studio 470 Verson
- Functional training
- Kettlebell coaching Normandie
- Fitness certifications (CQP, BPJEPS)
- Adapted physical activity
- Kettlebell instructor
- Caen fitness
- Strength training
- Versatile workout equipment
